feed.title: New head tracking mods in Lopari
feed.subtitle: One entry for each head tracking mod added to the Lopari catalog.

entry.title: No Man's Sky
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for No Man's Sky on Steam and Xbox Game Pass. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. On the Steam build tracking applies while you are looking through your own eyes; the Xbox Game Pass build routes every camera through one path, so it follows your head in third person too.

entry.title: Subliminal
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Subliminal on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps pointing at what you interact with, and the crosshair ring follows that point.

entry.title: Dying Light
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Dying Light on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming, and the crosshair moves to where your shot will land. Tracking pauses in menus, pause screens and cutscenes.

entry.title: Ghostrunner
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Ghostrunner on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming, and the crosshair follows the point your sword, shuriken and grapple are aimed at.

entry.title: Pathologic 2
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Pathologic 2 on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming, and an aim dot marks where your shot will land. Tracking runs in ordinary gameplay and stands down in menus, dialogue and cutscenes.

entry.title: The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming, and the crosshair moves to where your shot will land.

entry.title: Thief
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Thief on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming, and the crosshair moves to where your arrow will land.

entry.title: Black Mesa
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Black Mesa on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. Tracking runs in single-player gameplay and pauses while the game is paused, while a level loads, in deathmatch and on the menu background maps.

entry.title: TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge 3 on Steam. Your head moves the camera while your keyboard or controller keeps steering. Tracking runs while riding in free roam and in races, and pauses in menus, the pause screen and the map.

entry.title: Far Cry 6
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. Head tracking for Far Cry 6 on Steam and Ubisoft Connect. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. The mod takes the place of the head tracking library the game already ships, so there is no mod loader to install.

entry.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for the Xbox Game Pass / Microsoft Store build of Indiana Jones and the Great Circle. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. The Steam build is a different binary the mod has no profile for, so it stays dormant there and the game runs vanilla.

entry.title: Trepang2
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Trepang2 on Steam, GOG and Xbox Game Pass. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming, the torch turns with your head, and the crosshair moves to stay on the point the shot lands.

entry.title: Dishonored 2
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Dishonored 2 on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. The mod is tied to one build of Dishonored2.exe and stays dormant on any other, so the game runs vanilla.

entry.title: Outlast
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for Outlast via OpenTrack. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. Supports the Steam 64-bit build of 29 April 2014; on an unrecognised build the mod stays inactive.

entry.title: RoadCraft
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for RoadCraft on Steam, in the chase camera and the cockpit camera. Your head moves the view while your wheel or controller keeps steering.

entry.title: Stormworks: Build and Rescue
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Stormworks: Build and Rescue on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse keeps aiming. Tracking applies in a loaded save, not on the menus.

entry.title: Viewfinder
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Viewfinder on Steam. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. Head tracking fades out while a camera or photo is raised, so the shot you frame is the shot you get.

entry.title: Superliminal
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming the grab ray. Object resizing stays tied to mouse aim.

entry.title: The Witness
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. Head tracking for the Steam build of The Witness. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps control of look and interaction.

entry.title: Wolfenstein: The New Order
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Wolfenstein: The New Order on Steam or Xbox Game Pass. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. Steam and Xbox Game Pass ship different builds of the game and the mod carries addresses for each; on a build it does not recognise it stays dormant and the game runs vanilla.

entry.title: Starfield
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. 6DOF head tracking for Starfield version 1.16.244.0, on Steam or Xbox Game Pass. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps aiming. Ship lock-on acquisition follows your view.

entry.title: Portal
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for Portal on Steam via OpenTrack. Your head moves the camera while your mouse or controller keeps aiming the portal gun.

entry.title: The Vanishing of Ethan Carter Redux
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for The Vanishing of Ethan Carter Redux on Steam via OpenTrack. Your head moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps control of look and interaction. Supports the Steam Win64 executable with PE build date 15 September 2015; on an unrecognised build the mod stays dormant.

entry.title: Arx Fatalis
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for Arx Fatalis via OpenTrack. Your head moves the view while the mouse keeps aiming, and the cursor sits on the point you select with. The mod identifies the executable by its PE header and engages on the Steam and Xbox Game Pass builds of 1.21; on any other copy it stays dormant, leaves the game untouched, and says which way it differs in the log.

entry.title: BioShock Infinite
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for BioShock Infinite via OpenTrack. Your head moves the view while the mouse or controller keeps aiming, and tracking pauses by itself in the title, main and pause menus. The mod knows one build, the 2022-05-11 Steam one, and checks the executable before it hooks anything; on any other copy it stays dormant and names the mismatch in the log.

entry.title: Blue Prince
entry.summary: Works with any OpenTrack compatible tracker. Head tracking moves the view while your mouse or controller keeps control of look and interaction. Built and tested against the Xbox Game Pass build.

entry.title: Quake II RTX
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for Quake II RTX via OpenTrack. Your head moves the view while the mouse or controller keeps aiming, and the game's own crosshair is drawn on the point the shot will reach. The mod knows one build, the Steam 1.8.0 of 26 March 2025, and checks q2rtx.exe before it hooks anything; on any other copy it installs nothing and the game runs vanilla.

entry.title: SOMA
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for SOMA via OpenTrack. Your head moves the view while the mouse or controller keeps control of look and interaction, and the crosshair follows the game's own interaction ray so it marks what you are about to pick up. The mod identifies the executable by its PE header and covers both the Steam depot ships, Soma.exe and Soma_NoSteam.exe, each linked on 27 September 2021; on any other copy it stays dormant and the game runs vanilla.

entry.title: SnowRunner
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for SnowRunner via OpenTrack. Your head moves the camera while the wheel, pedals or controller keep driving, in the cab and in the exterior view. Supports the Steam and Xbox Game Pass builds of 22 July 2026; on any other build the mod stays dormant and the game runs vanilla.

entry.title: Amnesia: The Dark Descent
entry.summary: 6DOF head tracking for Amnesia: The Dark Descent via OpenTrack. Your head moves the view while the mouse still turns you and reaches for what you are grabbing. On a build whose signature the mod doesn't find it stays dormant and the game runs unmodified.
